entries.brief: One original SKAZ D&D 5e2014 spell icon. Classic painterly fantasy reference-book illustration, serious naturalistic materials, muted colors, soft warm key light, neutral shadows. No cartoons or chibi. Strong compact silhouette at32px, transparent RGBA background, square canvas, central75% with clear padding on every side. No text, letters, frame, watermark, scenery or diffuse outer bloom. A sturdy boot stepping free from loose open iron ankle shackles and slack rope, with a small leather strap tied at the ankle. Pale teal flowing freedom magic accents. Movement and release, no severed limbs, no shattered bones, no speed wings.

entries.revision: Refine this Guardian of Faith icon for SKAZ. Preserve the stationary spectral sentinel, upright sword and broad shield. Improve small-size clarity: remove most gauzy surrounding cloth mist, darken silver metal shadows and gold edges for readability on light paper, give the sword a distinct steel silhouette. Reduce entire subject to central75% square canvas with fully transparent12 percent margins all sides, especially above sword tip and below shield. No cropped edges, no letters or extra symbols. Keep painterly fantasy style and transparent background.
